tool.name: echo
tool.language: any; the bundle carries a mock adapter in Python

claims.claim: echo reads one JSON object from standard input and writes one JSON object to standard output
the exit status is zero whether echo answers or reports an error; the error is in the output
the input is an object with one required string field, message, which must not be empty
the output carries message, the same text, and length, the number of characters in message
a missing, non-string or empty message returns the error ECHO-INPUT-001 of category invalid_input, not retryable
length equals the character count of message, so it can be checked against an independent count of the same text
claims.limitations: derived from the output table's wording; whether length counts code points or UTF-16 units is not stated

claims.claim: echo has no state and no side effects

claims.requires: a statement in the documentation, or a run in a sandbox with growing messages

gaps.requires: a statement in the documentation, or a run in a sandbox with growing messages

gaps.what: the real echo binary behaves as the mock adapter does
gaps.requires: analysis_permission confirmed by a person (granted_by, scope, basis, date)
